name: astral-charts
description: Deterministic natal astrology calculation and strictly structured interpretation

scripts.test: rm -rf .test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node .test/test/run.js && node .test/test/calculation.js && node .test/test/geometry.js && node .test/test/points.js && node .test/test/dignity.js && node .test/test/derived.js && node .test/test/patterns.js && node .test/test/eclipses.js && node .test/test/compatibility.js && node .test/test/service.js && node .test/test/interfaces.js && node .test/test/chartFile.js && node .test/test/audit.js && node .test/test/openaiRuntime.js
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.vendor:astronomia: npm --prefix vendor/astronomia install && npm --prefix vendor/astronomia run build
scripts.vendor:places: npx --yes pnpm@9.0.0 --dir vendor/places install --frozen-lockfile && npx --yes pnpm@9.0.0 --dir vendor/places --filter @countrystatecity/countries build
scripts.vendor:time: npm --prefix vendor/time install && npm --prefix vendor/time/packages/core run build-dist && npm --prefix vendor/time/packages/timezone run build-dist
scripts.vendor:schema: npm --prefix vendor/openai-schema install && npm --prefix vendor/openai-schema run build
scripts.vendor:build: npm run vendor:astronomia && npm run vendor:places && npm run vendor:time && npm run vendor:schema
